description.zh: 图片Base64编码。如果您选择IdOcrPictureBase64（照片Base64编码）方式传入照片，请注意检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
description.en: The Base64-encoded image. If you choose to pass in the image by using IdOcrPictureBase64 (Base64-encoded photo), check the photo size and do not pass in an excessively large photo.

description.zh: 图片地址，公网可访问的HTTP、HTTPS链接。
description.en: The URL of the image. The URL must be a publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS link.

description.zh:
凭证类型。
- 交易凭据：01（包括：水、电、煤、信用卡等各类电子账单图片）
description.en:
The credential type. Valid values:
- 01: transaction credential (including electronic bill images for water, electricity, gas, credit cards, and other types).

description.zh:
是否开启篡改检测
- true：开启
- false：关闭
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable tampering detection. Valid values:
- true: Enabled.
- false: Disabled.

description.zh:
提取类型：
- 0101：电子账单地址&姓名模块（通过智能分析提取地址及姓名模块）
description.en:
The extraction type. Valid values:
- 0101: electronic bill address and name module (extracts the address and name module through intelligent analysis).

description.zh: 要接入的产品方案。取值CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION。
description.en: The product solution to use. Set this to CREDENTIAL_RECOGNITION.

descriptions.zh: 通过AI技术检测凭证（如水、电、煤、信用卡等电子账单）是否存在伪造，并对凭证进行关键信息提取。
descriptions.en: Uses AI technology to detect whether a credential (such as a water, electricity, gas, or credit card electronic bill) has been forged, and extracts key information from the credential.
